label: Interfaces bundle signals
subgoals: Group the bus signals into one interface declaration
Connect the interface as a single port
Expand the interface into individual nets at elaboration

label: Modports give directions
subgoals: Define one modport per role on the bus
Assign each signal a direction within each modport
Reject writes to signals the modport marks as inputs

label: Packages and compile order
subgoals: Collect shared types and constants into a package
Analyze each package before the code that imports it
Distinguish compile-time imports from elaboration-time instance binding
